bull.t: Strong cash generation and durable margins
bull.b: Robust operating cash flow (~$2.2B TTM) and meaningful free cash flow (~$1.5B) provide durable funding for new restaurants, equipment rollouts and buybacks. Coverage of operating cash vs. net income (~1.78x) indicates high earnings quality and resilience through near-term volatility.

bull.t: High digital penetration and growing loyalty
bull.b: Digital now drives a large share of sales and loyalty penetration (32%) is rising, creating recurring purchase behavior and lower incremental marketing need. Persistent digital adoption supports unit-level throughput, data-driven personalization and long-term margin tailwinds as fixed costs spread over higher digital volume.

bull.t: Scalable unit growth with attractive unit economics
bull.b: Aggressive, repeatable rollouts (heavy Chipotlane mix) and strong early international returns demonstrate scalable unit economics. High ROI on new openings and continued expansion cadence underpin multi-year revenue growth potential and margin expansion as newer, more efficient formats ramp.

bear.b: A materially higher debt-to-equity ratio (~3.48x) reduces financial flexibility and raises sensitivity to margin or demand shocks. Elevated leverage can constrain capital allocation choices, increase interest exposure, and limit the company's ability to absorb prolonged cost inflation or slower unit ramp periods.

bear.t: Sustained margin pressure from cost inflation
bear.b: Rising commodity, freight and labor costs have compressed restaurant margins (~250 bps Y/Y). If food and labor inflation persist, margin recovery will depend on sustained pricing, productivity or mix improvement; absent those, profitability and free cash flow conversion may remain pressured over the medium term.

bear.t: Conservative comp guidance and check/mix headwinds
bear.b: Flat full-year comp guidance and a 100-bp check drag signal demand uncertainty and mix challenges (loyalty redemptions, smaller party sizes). Slower traffic or persistent mix erosion can impede margin recovery and make it harder to leverage fixed costs from new-tech investments and unit expansion.
